title: webhook_endpoint.disabled
description: Published by webhooks when an endpoint's attempts have all failed for the configured time (72 hours by default) and it is disabled (data model §8; task 5.4). Its pending deliveries are dead from then on. Sent to the client's other active endpoints; monitoring's client alerts (Phase 16) turn it into email or SMS. Passing the verification challenge re-enables the endpoint. The endpoint's URL never appears here. This is the envelope's data field, not the whole envelope (see platform/events.Envelope).

failing_since.description: The first failed attempt since the endpoint's last success.

dead_deliveries.description: Pending deliveries ended because the endpoint was disabled; they can be replayed once it is re-enabled.
